reason: We already run the business and the house out of Notion and WhatsApp, and half of what we say to each other is voice notes. Rebuilding all our templates in a new app to save maybe one tool isn't worth a weekend we don't have.
objection: We'd lose our Notion setup and templates, and I don't see voice notes anywhere, so the real conversation would stay on WhatsApp anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A one-click import of our Notion pages and templates, plus voice notes in the built-in chat that turn into tasks.
